questions.question: Which state has become the 34th state to implement the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Odisha**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Odisha** has become the **34th state** to join the **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The scheme will work in **convergence** with the state's **Gopabandhu Jan Arogya Yojana (GJAY)**, providing comprehensive healthcare coverage.
 
• **Health cards** will be issued to beneficiaries, offering **₹5 lakh per family per year**, with an additional **₹5 lakh** for women members.
 
• The **MoU signing ceremony** was attended by **Union Health Minister JP Nadda**, **Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi**, and other key ministers including **Dharamendra Pradhan**, **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, and **Jual Oram**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Ayushman Bharat Overview:**

 
• **Launched**: As per the National Health Policy 2017, to achieve **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)** and align with the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• **Aim**: Provide comprehensive, need-based healthcare services at primary, secondary, and tertiary levels. Focuses on prevention, promotion, and ambulatory care.

Main Components:

 
• 
 
**Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs)**:

 
 
• **Objective**: Transform **Sub Centres** and **Primary Health Centres** into 1,50,000 Health and Wellness Centres by 2022.
 
• **Services**: Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC), maternal and child health, non-communicable diseases, essential drugs, and diagnostic services.
 
• **Focus**: Health promotion and prevention, empowering individuals and communities to adopt healthy behaviours and prevent chronic diseases.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)**:

 
 
• **Launched**: September 23, 2018, in Ranchi, Jharkhand.
 
• **Coverage**: ₹5 lakh per family per year for **secondary and tertiary care hospitalization** for **12 crore** poor and vulnerable families (about **55 crore beneficiaries**).
 
• **Eligibility**: Based on **Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011** (SECC), covers families previously under **Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY)**.
 
 

52:T

questions.question: Who will receive the Outstanding Lifetime Achievement Award at the Jaipur International Film Festival 2025, and who will be honored with a tribute for their cinematic legacy?

questions.question: Which is the highest Gallantry Award in wartime?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Param Vir Chakra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Param Vir Chakra is the highest gallantry award for officers and other enlisted personnel of all military branches of India** for the highest degree of valor in the presence of the enemy.
 
• Introduced on **January 26, 1950, this award may be given posthumously**. Literally, Param Vir Chakra means '**Wheel of the Ultimate Brave**'.
 
• In Sanskrit, 'Param' means Ultimate, 'Vir' means Brave and 'Chakra' means Wheel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Maha Vir Chakra:**

 
 
• The **Maha Vir Chakra is the second-highest military decoration in India** and is awarded for acts of conspicuous gallantry in the presence of the enemy, whether on land, at sea, or in the air.
 
• **It may be awarded posthumously**. More than 155 acts of bravery and selfless courage have been recognized since the inception of the medal.
 
• The most Mahavir Chakra awarded in a single conflict was in the India-Pakistan War of 1971 when eleven were given to the Indian Air Force.
 
 
 
• **Vir Chakra:**
 
 
• Vir Chakra is an Indian gallantry award **presented for acts of bravery on the battlefield**.
 
• Award of the decoration carried with it the right to use Vr.C. as a postnominal abbreviation (note the care to distinguish this abbreviation from that for the Victoria Cross).
 
• **It is third in precedence in the wartime gallantry awards** and comes after the Param Vir Chakra and Mahavir Chakra.
 
 
 
• **Ashok Chakra:**
 
 
• The Ashok Chakra series of awards are open to civilians also.
 
• **It is the Peacetime equivalent of Paramvir Chakra** and is awarded for the most conspicuous bravery or some daring or preeminent valor or sacrifice other than in the face of the enemy.
 
• The decoration may be **awarded either to military or civilian personnel and may be awarded posthumously**.
 
• These awards are biannual and are given on Republic Day and Independence Day.

questions.question: What was the record number of UPI transactions processed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) in December?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **16.7 billion**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• ** **UPI recorded 16.73 billion transactions in December 2024, an 8% rise from November (15.48 billion).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Transaction Volume and Value**:

 
 
• UPI recorded **16.73 billion transactions** in December 2024, an **8% rise from November** (15.48 billion).
 
• The total transaction value reached **₹23.25 lakh crore**, up from **₹21.55 lakh crore** in November.
 
 
 
• **Daily Transactions**: Average daily transactions in December were **539.68 million**, compared to **516.07 million** in November.
 
• **Notable Increase**: December's performance mirrors the surge seen in May 2024 (14.03 billion transactions), continuing the upward trend.
 
• **Volume Cap Compliance Extended**:
 
 
• The deadline for UPI volume cap compliance has been extended by **two years**, now set for **December 31, 2026**.
 
• This cap applies only to **third-party app providers (TPAPs)** like **PhonePe** and **Google Pay**, which dominate over **85% of the UPI market**.
 
 
 
• **Ease for WhatsApp Pay**: Restrictions on WhatsApp Pay were lifted, enabling its services to expand to all users.

questions.question: What was the language of people in the period of the Mauryan empire?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. __​Pali.__**

__
 
• The Mauryan kingdom was founded by **Chandragupta Maurya.**
 
• The most famous King of the Mauryan Empire was Ashoka.
 
• The last king of this empire was Brihadratha Maurya.
 
• Some important facts about the Mauryan empire are stated below;
 
 
• The Peacock was the state emblem of the Mauryas.
 
• **Pali was the language of the people.**
 
• The famous center of higher education during this period was Taxila.
 
• Kalpasutra was written by Bhadrabahu.
 
• Kathavastu was written by Moggaliputta Tissa.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• With the help of Chanakya (Vishnugupta/ Kautilya), Chandragupta Maurya defeated Dhana Nanda (322 BCE) and founded the Mauryan Dynasty.
 
• Chanakya encouraged Chandragupta Maurya and his army to take over the throne of Magadha.
 
• His vast empire included Bihar, Bengal, Deccan (except modern Kerala, Tamilnadu, and parts of Northeast India), Eastern Afghanistan, Baluchistan, and the area west of the Indus river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• B**indusara**

 
 
• Chandragupta was succeeded by his son Bindusara.
 
• Bindusara ruled for approximately 25-26 years and his succession was disputed which ultimately gave India a great king called Asoka.
 
 
 
• **Ashoka**
 
 
• Ashoka was the third and the greatest of the Mauryan rulers.
 
• Ashoka is referred to as Ashokavardhana.
 
 
 
• **Kunala**
 
 
• Kunala was the son of Emperor Ashoka and Queen Padmavati and the presumptive heir to Ashoka.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of SEBI's newly launched "when-listed" trading platform?

options.text: To allow investors to trade stocks after market closure
To reduce reliance on the grey market and eliminate volatility
To enable trading of international stocks in India
To provide a platform for trading only blue-chip stocks

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To reduce reliance on the grey market and eliminate volatility**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sebi is launching a regulated "when-listed" platform to allow investors to trade shares immediately after allotment, but before the official listing on stock exchanges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Addressing Grey Market**: The platform aims to eliminate the unregulated grey market, where speculative trading takes place between the allotment and listing phases.
 
• **Current System**: A three-day gap (T+1 to T+3) after IPO allotment often leads to grey market activity, where investors engage in unofficial trades.
 
• **Grey Market Risks**: It can lead to volatility and misled expectations due to speculative pricing and unpredictable outcomes based on listing day performance.
 
• **Investor Benefits**: The new platform ensures a transparent, secure trading environment, enhancing investor protection and stabilizing market sentiment.
 
• **Industry Support**: Experts agree that this initiative will reduce risks for retail investors and promote fair trading by legitimizing the process and curbing risky grey market transactions.

questions.question: What is the maximum loan amount eligible for the 60% guarantee coverage under the Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹100 crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The government launched the **Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs (MCGS-MSME)**, designed to boost the manufacturing sector by facilitating access to credit for MSMEs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The scheme provides **60% guarantee coverage by the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC)** for credit facilities up to ₹100 crore, specifically for purchasing equipment or machinery.
 
• **Eligibility criteria** for MSMEs to avail of the scheme include:
 
 
• Must have a valid **Udyam Registration Number**.
 
• Loan amounts guaranteed must not exceed **₹100 crore**.
 
• Minimum **75% of the project cost** must be for the purchase of equipment/machinery.
 
 
 
• **Guarantee fee structure**:
 
 
• **No fee** during the year of loan sanction.
 
• **1.5% annual fee** for the next three years based on the outstanding loan amount as of March 31 of the previous year.
 
• After three years, the annual guarantee fee drops to **1%** of the loan outstanding as of March 31 of the previous year.
 
 
 
• The scheme is available for **four years or until ₹7 lakh crore** in cumulative guarantees are issued, whichever comes first.
 
• The manufacturing sector, contributing **17% of India’s GDP** and employing over **27.3 million workers**, is set to benefit from this initiative.
 
• The scheme is expected to **boost manufacturing and ‘Make in India’** by providing MSMEs with easy access to credit for plant and machinery/equipment purchases, addressing one of the major costs involved in manufacturing.
 
• This initiative aligns with India’s push to emerge as an alternative supply chain source due to its **raw materials, low labor costs, manufacturing expertise**, and entrepreneurial potential.
 
• **Collateral-free loans** will be made available by banks and financial institutions to MSMEs, supporting their expansion and growth.
